purpose: Hallway connector set for Office Spider shots that track between the cubicle bay and the break room: Act I chair/stand/carry/walk (shots 5-6, SH050-SH080), Act II carry tracks (14, 18, 46), and the door beats (41, 47). Companion to specs/office_spider/stage_shots.v1.json (office) and breakroom_stage.v1.json (break room).
scale_note: Office-scale units (100 uu = 1 m). Corridor is 6 m wide x 40 m long x 3.2 m high, sized for tracking shots and door framing. All scenery is primitive cubes plus the office material instances; no imported prop kit is required, so the set is reproducible on a clean checkout.

placements.note: Thin slab, top face at z=0. 6 x 40 m.
Reads as a track lane for the carry shots; grout-free so the spider path reads on VCT at the edges.
Door at the -Y end (cubicle side). PowderCoat frame is implied by the wall material.

shots.name: stretch_break_medium
shots.framing_intent: Board pg1 shot 6: worker stretches/leans back, head/shoulder height against the corridor wall.

shots.name: hallway_track_carry
shots.framing_intent: Shots 5-6: carry walk down the corridor, tracking behind the worker; VCT edges + carpet runner read as path.

shots.name: sad_turn_profile
shots.framing_intent: Shot 46: profile track, worker shirt rim against the corridor wall.

shots.name: door_coworker_medium
shots.framing_intent: Shot 41: door medium, frosted glass reads the coworker silhouette.

shots.name: door_slam_entry
shots.framing_intent: Shot 47: door wide, SLAM entry; frosted glass shake is a camera impulse.

lighting.lighting_note: Corridor interior: sun through implied windows at the door ends, movable lights. Practicals are troffers.

practicals.label: LGT_Hall_Counter
practicals.why: overhead troffer band near the office end.

practicals.label: LGT_Hall_Counter2
practicals.why: overhead troffer band near the break-room end.

practicals.label: LGT_Hall_Fill
practicals.why: camera-side fill to lift the corridor mid-tones.

deferred.reason: carry + TINK uses the same corridor track; camera can reuse Cam_HW_SH080 with a mug prop (mug material gap).
reverse track reuses Cam_HW_SH080 flipped; no new scenery.
under-desk hide is an office-set shot, not hallway; uses L_Toon_Shot_Office.
spray run uses kitchen/break-room set, not hallway.

evidence_contract.stills_note: Each still committed via the shared harness (render_prototypes.py) with this spec's camera list. PNGs are evidence only through the report's measured IHDR dimensions.
evidence_contract.shader_read_note: Minimum passes: VCT grout on floor, carpet loop on runner, environment wall material, frosted glass door, troffer emissive.
